description: A JavaScript function that returns JSX. The reusable building block of every React UI.
You describe what the UI should look like for the current state; React computes the DOM changes. Summarized as `UI = f(state)`.
Data travels from parent to child through props. Children request changes by calling functions the parent passed down.
The process of comparing the new element tree with the previous one to find the minimal DOM updates. Implemented by the Fiber architecture.
A package that connects React to a platform: `react-dom` (web), `react-native` (mobile) and others.
